messages:
alex: FYI running into ESM/CJS + Edge problems using the JS SDK in a Next app-router app. build/runtime errors.

maria: what errors?

alex: sometimes `TypeError: require is not a function` at build; other times `Cannot use import statement outside a module`. On Vercel Edge I hit `setTimeout is not defined` in our retry path.

jamal: sounds like consumers are resolving the wrong entrypoint. do we have an exports map?

alex: package.json only had main/module/types. no exports.

maria: add exports with import/require/edge and ship an `index.edge.mjs` that avoids node builtins. also ship `index.edge.d.ts` and a tiny browser bundle for client components.

sophie: TS tip: dynamic import tricks in server components can yield `any` unless per-entrypoint `.d.ts` are provided or typesVersions is used.

jamal: retry change: detect `globalThis.setTimeout` and fallback to a microtask loop or `fetch` Retry-After for edge-compatible backoff.

alex: short-term hack: import the edge build directly in server components: `await import('redwood-infer-sdk/dist/index.edge.mjs')` to unblock tests.

maria: can someone open an SDK issue and attach a repro?

sophie: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/312 and linked the repro.

build-bot: CI queued for branch fix/edge-exports (CI #3421) :rocket:

maria: plan: exports map + edge/browser bundles + per-entrypoint types + retry fallback. assigning to @jamal and @maria.
